arbejder_laas_fri: SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @r int; EXEC @r = sp_getapplock @Resource=?, @LockMode='Exclusive', @LockOwner='Session', @LockTimeout=0; SELECT @r

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Motors WHERE id=?) INSERT INTO dbo.Motors (id, aendret) VALUES (?, SYSUTCDATETIME()); UPDATE dbo.Motors SET model_commit=?, data_commit=?, aendret=SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id=?

SELECT CAST(id AS nvarchar(36)) id, arbejder_id, DATEDIFF(second, COALESCE(hjerteslag, startet), SYSUTCDATETIME()) alder_s FROM dbo.Koersels WHERE status IN ('koerer','indlaeser') AND ISNULL(arbejder_id, '') <> ? AND COALESCE(hjerteslag, startet) >= DATEADD(second, -?, SYSUTCDATETIME())

UPDATE dbo.Koersels SET status='fejl', afsluttet=SYSUTCDATETIME(), fase=N'Fejl', fejlbesked=N'Arbejderen stoppede uden at afslutte kørslen (fx fordi jobbet blev stoppet eller kapaciteten sat på pause). Bestil kørslen igen.' OUTPUT CAST(inserted.id AS nvarchar(36)) id WHERE status IN ('koerer','indlaeser') AND ISNULL(arbejder_id, '') <> ? AND COALESCE(hjerteslag, startet) < DATEADD(second, -?, SYSUTCDATETIME())

UPDATE dbo.Koersels SET status='koerer', arbejder_id=?, hjerteslag=SYSUTCDATETIME(), startet=SYSUTCDATETIME(), forsoeg=forsoeg+1 WHERE id=? AND status IN ('koe','startet') AND annuller_anmodet IS NULL
SELECT CAST(id AS nvarchar(36)) id, input_hash, status, vaerk_revision, CAST(vaerk_id AS nvarchar(36)) vaerk_id FROM dbo.Koersels WHERE id=?
SELECT kilde, sti, vaerdi_json FROM dbo.KoerselInputs WHERE koersel_id=?
SELECT status, annuller_anmodet, arbejder_id FROM dbo.Koersels WHERE id=?
UPDATE dbo.Koersels SET fase=? WHERE id=? AND arbejder_id=? AND status IN ('koerer','indlaeser')
UPDATE dbo.Koersels SET hjerteslag=SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id=? AND arbejder_id=? AND status IN ('koerer','indlaeser')
SELECT status, annuller_anmodet, arbejder_id FROM dbo.Koersels WHERE id=?
SELECT sti FROM dbo.Tidsseries WHERE id=?
UPDATE dbo.Koersels SET model_commit=?, data_commit=?, startet=SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id=? AND arbejder_id=? AND status IN ('koerer','indlaeser')
UPDATE dbo.Koersels SET status=? WHERE id=? AND status=? AND arbejder_id=? AND annuller_anmodet IS NULL
SELECT status, arbejder_id, annuller_anmodet FROM dbo.Koersels WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE id=?

INSERT INTO dbo.KoerselNoegletals (id, koersel_id, gruppe, objekt, marked, noegle, vaerdi, enhed) SELECT NEWID(), ?, j.gruppe, j.objekt, j.marked, j.noegle, j.vaerdi, j.enhed FROM OPENJSON(?) WITH (gruppe nvarchar(60) '$.g', objekt nvarchar(120) '$.o', marked nvarchar(20) '$.m', noegle nvarchar(120) '$.n', vaerdi decimal(28,10) '$.v', enhed nvarchar(40) '$.e') j
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.KoerselNoegletals WHERE koersel_id=?
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 x FROM dbo.KoerselNoegletals WHERE koersel_id=? GROUP BY gruppe, objekt, marked, noegle HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.KoerselMaaneds WHERE koersel_id=?
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 x FROM dbo.KoerselMaaneds WHERE koersel_id=? GROUP BY maaned, objekt, noegle HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.KoerselTimes WHERE koersel_id=?
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 x FROM dbo.KoerselTimes WHERE koersel_id=? GROUP BY tid HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d
UPDATE dbo.Koersels SET status='faerdig', afsluttet=SYSUTCDATETIME(), fase=N'Færdig', objektiv_dkk=?, fase=? WHERE id=? AND status='indlaeser' AND arbejder_id=? AND annuller_anmodet IS NULL

;WITH n AS (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM dbo.Koersels WITH (UPDLOCK, READPAST, ROWLOCK) WHERE status IN ('koe','startet') AND annuller_anmodet IS NULL ORDER BY modtaget, id) UPDATE n SET status='koerer', arbejder_id=?, hjerteslag=SYSUTCDATETIME(), startet=SYSUTCDATETIME(), forsoeg=forsoeg+1 OUTPUT CAST(inserted.id AS nvarchar(36)) id
SELECT CAST(id AS nvarchar(36)) id, input_hash, status, vaerk_revision, CAST(vaerk_id AS nvarchar(36)) vaerk_id FROM dbo.Koersels WHERE id=?
SELECT kilde, sti, vaerdi_json FROM dbo.KoerselInputs WHERE koersel_id=?
SELECT status, annuller_anmodet, arbejder_id FROM dbo.Koersels WHERE id=?
UPDATE dbo.Koersels SET fase=? WHERE id=? AND arbejder_id=? AND status IN ('koerer','indlaeser')
UPDATE dbo.Koersels SET hjerteslag=SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id=? AND arbejder_id=? AND status IN ('koerer','indlaeser')
SELECT status, annuller_anmodet, arbejder_id FROM dbo.Koersels WHERE id=?
SELECT sti FROM dbo.Tidsseries WHERE id=?
UPDATE dbo.Koersels SET model_commit=?, data_commit=?, startet=SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id=? AND arbejder_id=? AND status IN ('koerer','indlaeser')
UPDATE dbo.Koersels SET status=?, fejlbesked=?, afsluttet=SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id=? AND status=? AND arbejder_id=?

;WITH n AS (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM dbo.Koersels WITH (UPDLOCK, READPAST, ROWLOCK) WHERE status IN ('koe','startet') AND annuller_anmodet IS NULL ORDER BY modtaget, id) UPDATE n SET status='koerer', arbejder_id=?, hjerteslag=SYSUTCDATETIME(), startet=SYSUTCDATETIME(), forsoeg=forsoeg+1 OUTPUT CAST(inserted.id AS nvarchar(36)) id
